snippet.title: Of Ash and Steel - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Purchase Of Ash and Steel now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893820/Of_Ash_and_Steel/
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/of_ash_and_steel

Of Ash and Steel is an old-school third-person open-world RPG set in a cruel medieval world. Make your path from abandoned lowlife to a marshal of fortunes, choose your side, and forge alliances on your journey to discover the truth of who you really are. Rediscover the joy of exploration and let curiosity be your guide; the island where the story takes place promises rich rewards for those who dare to uncover its secrets.

⚔️⚔️⚔️

Follow the game on socials and join the community:
Discord: https://discord.gg/QDZNNxZmE4
X: https://x.com/OfAshandSteel
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@ofashandsteel
